scenes.title: WALK FROM ASIA TO AMERICA
scenes.say: You could once walk from Asia to America. Lower the sea by 130 metres and the Bering Strait dries out into a land bridge called Beringia.

scenes.title: ICE AGE WORLD
scenes.small:
Beringia supported herds of
horses and mammoths
scenes.say: Scientists say this land supported herds of horses and mammoths, during the last ice age, when sea level was about 130 metres lower than today.
